cases.name: static_first
cases.source:
let items: List<Text> = ["start","middle","end"]
let numerator = number(5)
let denominator = number(2)
let fraction = numerator / denominator
let dividend = number(10)
let divisor = number(3)
let remainder = dividend % divisor
var index = fraction
index += remainder
index *= 2
index -= 7
index /= 2
setClipboard(index)
let observed = items[0]
return observed
